title: Replace symbolic seams with real interfaces or remove them
description:
Review packages/core/src/seams.ts.

It currently functions more as symbolic scaffolding than as enforced architecture. Replace empty marker interfaces with real contracts where useful, or remove/retire the file so it does not misrepresent architectural enforcement.
acceptance_criteria:
- Empty marker interfaces are removed or replaced with meaningful contracts.
- Any retained seams are used by runtime code or tests.
- Documentation no longer implies unused marker interfaces enforce architecture.
- Existing imports/tests are updated.
notes: Execution note: During this bead, resolve remaining Biome noBannedTypes warnings only where the correct replacement follows from the real interface/removal decision. Do not replace {} mechanically just to satisfy lint.
close_reason: Removed packages/core/src/seams.ts and its self-referential test; cleaned up internal.ts re-exports and 'Fills the X seam' JSDoc trailers. PR #76.
